extends SceneTree

func _init() -> void:
	var scene := load("res://scenes/Main.tscn") as PackedScene
	var instance := scene.instantiate()
	root.add_child(instance)

	var builder := instance as LevelBuilder
	builder.build()

	# Verify grid contents from level.json
	print("Testing get_item (JSON grid):")
	print("(0,0,0) -> ", builder.get_item(0,0,0), " (expected 0)")
	print("(0,0,1) -> ", builder.get_item(0,0,1), " (expected 1)")
	print("(2,1,2) -> ", builder.get_item(2,1,2), " (expected 0)")
	print("(9,9,9) -> ", builder.get_item(9,9,9), " (expected -1)")

	# Verify MeshLibrary colors are distinct
	var grid_map := builder.get_node("GridMap") as GridMap
	var ml := grid_map.mesh_library
	var colors := []
	for i in range(3):
		var mesh := ml.get_item_mesh(i) as BoxMesh
		var mat := mesh.surface_get_material(0) as StandardMaterial3D
		colors.append(mat.albedo_color.to_html())
		print("Item ", i, " color: ", mat.albedo_color)
	print("Unique colors: ", colors)

	# Test place/remove
	builder.place(2, 5, 5, 5)
	print("After place(2,5,5,5), get(5,5,5) -> ", builder.get_item(5,5,5))
	builder.remove(5, 5, 5)
	print("After remove(5,5,5), get(5,5,5) -> ", builder.get_item(5,5,5))

	# Verify build() can be called again (clears previous)
	builder.place(99, 0,0,0)
	print("Before second build, (0,0,0) -> ", builder.get_item(0,0,0))
	builder.build()
	print("After second build, (0,0,0) -> ", builder.get_item(0,0,0))

	quit()
